result.reason: The redline caps the Company's termination payment at three months' fees and retains 90 days' notice, satisfying part of the fallback. However, it leaves HDI with the same apparent right to terminate on 90 days' notice during a committed term; the fallback permits Vendor convenience termination only at the end of a term. The clause also does not clearly establish that the Company's right may be exercised mid-term. The changes are otherwise targeted and professionally drafted, although the operative language does not fully reach the playbook position.
